definitions.explanation: What is typical or usual, not specialized or exceptional.
Ordinary people as opposed to specialists or officials.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一般的|いっぱんてき}に→一般的：04784_ippanteki⟧⟦{言|い}えば→言う：00515_iu⟧。
{一般|いっぱん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
⟦{一般的|いっぱんてき}に→一般的：04784_ippanteki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧そう⟦{考|かんが}えられている→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{例外|れいがい}→例外：03798_reigai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: That's generally how it's understood, but there are exceptions.

examples.japanese: {一般|いっぱん}⟦{公開|こうかい}されています→公開：11665_koukai⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一般|いっぱん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ご⟦{利用|りよう}いただけます→利用：01752_riyou⟧。
examples.english: This facility is available to the general public as well.

notes:
{一般|いっぱん} has two main uses: (1) 'general, ordinary' as opposed to specialized or exceptional, and (2) 'the general public' as opposed to professionals or officials.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {一般|いっぱん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun: ordinary ~
- {一般|いっぱん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: generally, in general
- ⟦{一般的|いっぱんてき}→一般的：04784_ippanteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: generally (more common in speech)
- {一般|いっぱん}⟦{公開|こうかい}→公開：11665_koukai⟧: open to the public
- {一般|いっぱん}⟦{向|む}け→向け：11011_muke⟧: aimed at the general public

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{一般的|いっぱんてき}→一般的：04784_ippanteki⟧: general (na-adjective)
- ⟦{一般人|いっぱんじん}→一般人：22733_ippanjin⟧: ordinary person (as opposed to celebrity or specialist)
- {一般|いっぱん}⟦{常識|じょうしき}→常識：03287_joushiki⟧: common knowledge
- {一般|いっぱん}⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧: ordinary company (non-specialized)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧: ordinary, usual (more colloquial and subjective)
- {一般|いっぱん}: general (more formal, used for categories and classifications)
